snippet.title: Orc's Bride | Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Hack and Slash, Beat 'em UP Acion Game Orc's Bride will be released on   December 26, 2023
STEAM : [https://store.steampowered.com/app/2727020/Orcs_Bride/]

She was proposed to by the Orc Prince.
 A goverment fearful of war with the Orc Empire decided to hand her over and placed a hefty bounty on her. 

In this world, everyone is an enemy. Fight and keep on fighting.
